The image corresponds to the moment during dinner at the hotel when the driver arrives with Poveda to report that a bus part is missing; he cannot obtain it until the next day because he has to go into town, meaning they must spend the night there. Garviza and Bráñez want to go fetch the part, but Poveda declines, citing the rain. Rosario, incredulous, decides to go to the window to check the weather; Poveda accompanies her and presses a button that signals a colleague of his—a special effects operator—who then triggers the rain using a switch. Beside Garviza stands the femme fatale with her hands clasped in a pleading attitude and an expression between surprise and horror.
